gates.description: Claudy profile menu DPAPI round-trip and project-local Claude-to-Codex bridge work without network access

gates.disposition_reason: Claudy profile/Codex menu was deleted and replaced by the project-local router menu.

gates.description: Project-local Claude binary, pinned Claude Code Router metadata/runtime, isolated launcher, verified-start handling and offline version checks are present
gates.invariant: One local Claude CLI uses only the project-local CCR gateway boundary and pinned router/runtime artifacts; a stale start exit cannot override a verified gateway postcondition, while an unverified start remains fail-closed without reading ignored secrets or using provider calls

gates.description: Project-local router menu verifies setting schema/merge, DPAPI storage, verified gateway startup and Claude-only launch behavior without provider access
gates.invariant: The router menu derives routes from ignored setting.json, keeps credentials project-local, accepts startup only after independent process/loopback/health verification, starts only bin/claude.exe through the local gateway, and performs no provider CLI invocation during self-test

gates.description: Ignored root setting.json, tracked secret-free example, prompt-free RUN menu and project-local account-only SIGN_ACCOUNT entry are deterministic
gates.invariant: The owner edits API routes only in ignored setting.json, RUN never asks for new API data, account login stays in project-local homes, and no normal entry point exposes CCR agent profiles that can mutate external apps

gates.description: Folder-local Codex browser login is isolated per account, route-ID compatible, retry-safe, entitlement-filtered and exposed as separate model routes without reading real credentials
gates.invariant: SIGN_ACCOUNT invokes only the pinned project-local Codex binary for browser login, stores each account under a separate project-local CODEX_HOME, reloads route IDs generated from supported account labels, resumes unfinished local login safely, excludes rejected ChatGPT-account fallbacks, enumerates every retained model as a separate route, never discovers global Windows auth, never prints credentials, and exposes each imported route through the one Claude CLI harness

gates.description: Project launchers remove CCR agent profiles and never expose global/App takeover controls
gates.invariant: CCR is only a project-local provider gateway; System default, CLI & APP and other agent-profile paths cannot modify external Codex/Claude configuration through normal project entry points

gates.description: Pinned CLIProxyAPI upstream and bounded updater/callback isolation patches are independently reproducible
gates.invariant: The challenger checkout is clean at the exact four-commit reviewed patch series above the audited upstream tag; local-model suppresses update requests and Antigravity OAuth callback binds only to IPv4 loopback

gates.description: Seven-slot project-local account onboarding contract distinguishes three Codex Free, one Plus and three Google Pro accounts
gates.invariant: Onboarding preserves the existing Codex Free slot, adds two more Free slots, one Codex Plus and three Google Pro slots with plan-specific model/usage groups, no secret-shaped data and automatic fallback disabled

gates.description: RUN menu starts a non-blocking verified router warmup without touching credentials, providers or Codex App state
gates.invariant: Routes render before a hidden project-local warmup; route selection still verifies exact process, loopback and health before DPAPI access, while no global Codex/App switching or provider request is introduced

gates.description: Google Pro OAuth onboarding remains hash-pinned, current-user-only and callback-loopback-only
gates.invariant: Each Google Pro slot owns one ignored auth directory; the wrapper invokes only the pinned challenger OAuth command on a fixed free loopback callback port and never reads credential content or global app state

gates.description: Secret-free provider usage contract preserves both Google AI Pro weekly quota branches
gates.invariant: Google AI Pro has independent gemini_models and claude_gpt_models weekly windows; five-hour data is optional and unavailable values remain explicitly unknown rather than fabricated

gates.description: Pinned challenger binary passes an isolated loopback Anthropic protocol pilot
gates.invariant: The hash-pinned challenger uses project-local runtime/auth paths, current-user-only ACL, loopback listeners, no observed external connection, bounded startup/restart, and translates Claude non-stream, SSE and one tool-result round trip against a deterministic local fixture

gates.description: Finite account-aware fallback policy respects weekly/five-hour quota and output side-effect boundaries
gates.invariant: Every fallback target is account/model allowlisted with its own quota observation; known five-hour depletion blocks eligibility, unknown five-hour permits only signal-driven reactive fallback, and no retry occurs after output or a tool side effect

gates.description: Dashboard candidate source is pinned, unrun and blocked until licensing and isolation are resolved
gates.invariant: EasyCLIProxyAPI remains an ignored source-only reference at one exact tag/commit/tree; no runtime/OAuth/provider use is permitted and the missing license plus update/global-agent/tray/auth-file risks stay explicit

gates.description: One-door localhost dashboard safely owns account onboarding, quota refresh and exact Claude route launches
gates.invariant: DASHBOARD.bat binds only loopback, keeps credentials server-side, uses only project-local runtimes, preserves unknown provider quota, launches exact allowlisted routes in separate terminals and leaves SIGN_ACCOUNT as a compatibility redirect

gates.description: Dashboard button actions acknowledge real launcher startup, suppress phantom sessions, survive bounded server restarts and resume through a selected route
gates.invariant: A visible dashboard cannot claim an account/model terminal opened before its project-local helper acknowledges startup; only sessions with local transcripts are listed, the authenticated loopback browser session survives a supervised server restart, updates settle independently, and resume may use any currently allowlisted route

gates.description: Session identity is route-independent and one exact session UUID cannot be launched concurrently
gates.invariant: Resuming through a different account/model updates only last-used route metadata; origin identity and friendly name remain stable, multiple new terminals may share one account/model through distinct UUIDs, and one exact UUID is rejected while already launching or running

gates.description: Dashboard deletes one exact closed Claude session into recoverable project-local trash
gates.invariant: Session deletion requires explicit confirmation, rejects active terminals, selects only exact UUID transcript files under the isolated Claude home and moves them with a manifest into ignored project-local trash instead of permanently deleting content

gates.description: Dashboard clears only closed terminal history while preserving running processes and sessions
gates.invariant: Terminal-history cleanup requires explicit confirmation, recomputes and retains running PIDs, and changes only the ignored dashboard terminal registry without stopping a process or deleting session/transcript data

gates.description: Dashboard discovers Google models dynamically and removes exact accounts/providers into recoverable local trash
gates.invariant: Transient Antigravity model IDs are never hard-coded; account removal requires exact confirmation, refuses active routes and moves only the selected project-local account/provider state into ignored recoverable trash

gates.description: Google runtime repairs stale/reused PID markers without touching unrelated processes
gates.invariant: A reused or malformed project PID marker is discarded, a mismatched process is never stopped, and only the exact hash-pinned project runtime may be restarted or terminated
